messages.content:
Last week the lobby kiosk lost power while kvstore was saving its settings, and its
store file came back cut off in the middle. After that every kvstore command on the
kiosk crashed with a JSONDecodeError traceback. kvstore rewrites the store file in
place, so any write that is interrupted leaves a broken file behind. I copied the
kiosk's damaged file to incidents/2026-10-27-lobby-kiosk.json. Please:

- make writes safe: when set, update, or delete cannot finish writing the file (a value
  that cannot be stored as JSON, a full disk), the store file should keep its previous
  content, the Store object its previous values, and no temporary file should be left
  next to it. The kvstore command should print the error and exit with status 1 instead
  of showing a traceback;
- when a store file is damaged (not valid JSON), opening it should raise StoreError with
  a message that names the file, and every kvstore command should print that error and
  exit with status 2 without touching the file;
- add kvstore recover DAMAGED OUT, which writes every entry of DAMAGED that was
  completely written to the new store file OUT and prints how many entries it
  recovered. An entry only counts when its value is followed by a comma or the closing
  brace, so a value cut off at the end of the file is left out. recover should only read
  DAMAGED, and it should exit with status 2 instead of overwriting an existing OUT;
- recover has to work on the kiosk's file: it should get back every setting that was
  completely written before the power cut, so that we can set the kiosk up again.

Everything else should keep working as it does now: the commands and their output, the
file format (sorted keys, two-space indent, a final newline), and the store file's
permissions when it is rewritten.
